name: agx-coralhz-s135
setup: subwave.worldClock.setDayFraction(0.32); subwave.player.lampOn = false; const a = subwave.jumpTo('coral'); __shot.place(a.x, a.y, a.z, a.yaw, -0.06); import('/src/core/constants.js').then(m => { Object.assign(m.RENDER, {"AGX_LOOK_SATURATION": 1.35}); try { subwave.snapWaterColumn(subwave.player.position); } catch (e) {} subwave.renderer.camera.resetHistory(); subwave.renderer.resetAdaptation(); setTimeout(() => subwave.setPaused(true), 1200); });
